verdict.rationale: CDP ships some configure-once behaviors that run without further action. Deposit destinations auto-credit accounts, and liquidation addresses automatically convert incoming funds before crediting. USDC subscriptions use spend permissions for recurring pulls. Agentic Wallet lets an agent pay x402 services automatically within configurable per-session and per-transaction caps. However, there is no general automation builder, scheduler, or rule engine, and the Base MCP wallet requires approval for every write action. Webhooks are only building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation or workflow feature (triggers, schedules, recurring payouts), documented background execution beyond deposit auto-conversion and subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
